cards.title: Magic-state sampling precision
cards.role: Defines the quantitative sampling-precision claim counted as T004.

checks.reason: The inverse-square-root finite-sampling law is stated explicitly in Sec. VII B.

cards.numerical_form: Repeat independent fidelity estimates at several shot counts and fit log standard deviation versus log N_tot.

cards.title: Runtime benchmark claim and complexity boundary
cards.role: Separates the published qualitative tenfold speedup from unrecoverable absolute wall-clock values.

checks.reason: Fig. 11 states an approximately tenfold speedup at p=10^-3 but provides no benchmark host or software-version metadata.
The isolated local proxy confirms the algorithmic low-p speedup direction but is explicitly excluded from absolute timing reproduction.

cards.numerical_form: Benchmark both methods on one declared environment for a qualitative speedup check; do not compare absolute seconds without the authors' environment.
open_questions: The paper does not identify the processor, operating system, Stim/Cirq versions, compilation settings, or timing protocol used for Fig. 11.
